workflow_runs.display_title: fix(cloud-tasks): respect cli_auth_credentials_store config

head_commit.message:
fix(cloud-tasks): respect cli_auth_credentials_store config

Previously, cloud-tasks always instantiated AuthManager with File mode
by calling load_from_base_config_with_overrides on an empty ConfigToml.
This ignored the user's actual cli_auth_credentials_store setting.

Changes:
- Add util::load_cli_auth_manager() helper that properly loads user config
  via load_config_as_toml_with_cli_overrides
- Update init_backend() and build_chatgpt_headers() to use this helper
- Now respects keyring/auto settings correctly

Fixes issue where users with cli_auth_credentials_store = "keyring" would
see "Not signed in" when running codex cloud.
